title: Management pages compute from only the first 20 rows of each list

persona.name: 青禾｜2330 台股 Paper 學習 R2

ac1_shared_all_pages_helper_and_page_cap.detail: Extracted collectPaginatedListPages (with PAGINATED_LIST_PAGE_SIZE=200 and MAX_PAGINATED_LIST_PAGES=25) in src/lib/bff-v1/lists.ts and wired listPersonas, listCapitalPools, listRuntimes, listDeployments, lists.personas, lists.capitalPools, lists.runtimes, and lists.deployments to it. Multi-page tests in domainReads.allPages.test.ts and lists.test.ts prove rows on page 2 arrive and reaching maxPages reports strict fallback via liveStatus.reportFallback and throws BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE without silently truncating.

ac2_no_first_page_unfiltered_strategy_re.detail: Removed unfiltered first-page listStrategies / bffV1.strategies.list and replaced it with listNonDraftStrategies (bffV1.strategies.listNonDraft using exclude_state=draft across all pages) and listStrategiesForPersona (bffV1.strategies.listForPersona using persona_id=<id> across all pages). Deleted unmounted dead-code caller src/management/pages/CommandCenter.tsx.

ac3_persona_and_deployment_list_pages_sh.detail: PersonasList and DeploymentsList consume lists.personas and lists.deployments backed by collectPaginatedListPages and normalizeDeploymentFields (mapping native plan_id, target_stage, artifact_version, strategy_id, artifact_id, sponsor_persona_id). Tests in Lists.test.tsx prove rows past the first 20 rows render in the table.

ac4_risk_center_non_draft_strategies_all.detail: RiskCenter loads strategies via bffV1.strategies.listNonDraft(), personas/pools/runtimes via their all-pages list readers, and open incidents via bffV1.incidents.list({ status: NON_TERMINAL_INCIDENT_STATUS_FILTER }) ('open,investigating,mitigating,in_progress') while filtering out any terminal ('resolved'/'closed') statuses. The Drawdown KPI card, Breach Matrix, and Strategies tab explicitly display t('riskCenter.draftsExcluded').

ac5_risk_center_independent_loading_and_.detail: RiskCenter tracks an independent DomainSlice ('loading' | 'ready' | 'error') for each of its 6 reads. Cards show t('common.loading') until their read resolves and t('status.unavailable') when their read fails while other cards whose reads succeeded still render their real counts; no card shows 0 while loading or after a failure.

ac6_persona_detail_real_rows_and_error_u.detail: PersonaDetail and PersonaCapitalBindingTab load persona strategies via bffV1.strategies.listForPersona(personaId) and all capital pools via bffV1.capitalPools.list(), rendering strategy-persona-298e138c136c9840b0e4 and pool-persona-paper-298e138c136c9840b0e4 for persona-be19a1fac471247f2b2a. When a read rejects, both tabs render t('status.unavailable') instead of t('empty.noResults').

ac7_capital_pool_incident_and_rebalance_.detail: CapitalPoolDetail, IncidentDetail, and RebalanceDetail resolve strategies from bffV1.strategies.listNonDraft().

ac8_ranking_formula_detail_no_browser_sc.detail: RankingFormulaDetail no longer calls bffV1.strategies or computes (s.sharpe * 0.6 - Math.abs(s.drawdown) * 0.4) in the browser, formats appliedTo via formatFormulaAppliedTo so the literal word 'undefined' is never rendered, and either renders owner-supplied ranking rows or links to the Rankings Center (/management/rankings).

ac9_tool_detail_no_fabricated_strategy_c.detail: ToolDetail no longer slices the first 4 rows of bffV1.strategies as fabricated consumers; it renders only real consumer relations present on the tool DTO or t('common.noData').

ac10_drawdown_breach_sign_verified_again.detail: Verified against owner /bff/strategies and backtest_metrics DTOs that max_drawdown / drawdown is stored as a positive fractional ratio (e.g., 0.18 for 18% drawdown). Updated RiskCenter.isDrawdownBreach to check s.drawdown > DRAWDOWN_BREACH_THRESHOLD (0.1) and verified with unit and component tests in RiskCenter.test.tsx.

ac11_no_weakened_or_deleted_tests_and_ch.detail: No existing test was weakened or deleted. All updated test references to bffV1.strategies.list were migrated to bffV1.strategies.listNonDraft or bffV1.strategies.listForPersona as required by AC 2.
